## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.21 — Release pipeline split

> **Alpha.** No app changes. This exists to prove the new release pipeline.

The release workflow is now four jobs — `build`, `android`, `sign`, `publish` —
instead of one, so each credential is held by the smallest job that needs it.

Signing secrets moved out of repository scope into a `signing` environment.
That closed a real hole rather than a theoretical one: another workflow has a
pull-request trigger, and a branch PR could previously have read the app
signing key — the one key here that cannot be rotated.

Alpha tags publish unattended; a stable release now waits for a human. Alphas
are the development loop and should not need a confirmation each time, but a
stable build goes to people who did not sign up to be testers.

Artifacts are unchanged: signed APK, signed `SHA256SUMS.asc`, same binaries.
